Container.Name: AussieTV
Container.Overview: Docker-hosted Australian TV guide and player, with an optional keyed Jellyfin M3U/XMLTV feed. Configure an HTTPS reverse proxy on a trusted private network and an exact browser origin before use. Do not expose these ports to the Internet. No bundled broadcaster subscriptions or DRM bypass.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent guide and artwork cache, optional provider/config files. Directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001.

Config.Name: TV Web Port
Config.Description: Private-network HTTP backend for your HTTPS proxy. Do not port-forward.

Config.Name: Browser Origin
Config.Description: Required exact HTTPS origin, e.g. https://tv.example.test (no trailing slash). Set the WebUI link in Advanced View to this same URL.

Config.Name: TV Username
Config.Description: Shared browser login username.

Config.Name: TV Password
Config.Description: Generate a unique random secret, at least 24 characters. Do not reuse your Unraid password.

Config.Name: TV Listener
Config.Description: Container listener; keep the fixed port.

Config.Name: Server Mode
Config.Description: Headless server, no desktop browser launch.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Listener
Config.Description: Optional: set 0.0.0.0:45782 and fill in the base URL and key to enable the feed.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Feed Port
Config.Description: Optional: map to 45782 when enabling Jellyfin. Restrict to trusted clients.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Base URL
Config.Description: URL reachable by Jellyfin, no trailing path or query.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Key
Config.Description: Separate random secret of at least 24 characters.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Region
Config.Description: Region used by Jellyfin M3U and XMLTV.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Transport
Config.Description: redirect recommended; relay, mpegts and fast-tune are experimental.

Config.Name: Repair Jellyfin Artwork
Config.Description: Set to 1 to fill missing Live TV programme posters directly. Requires AussieTV as the only tuner and guide provider.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Server URL
Config.Description: Jellyfin server address, preferably HTTPS. Not the AussieTV feed URL.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Administrator API Key
Config.Description: Create a dedicated Jellyfin API key for artwork repair. Distinct from the read-only feed key. Do not share.

Config.Name: Additional Providers File
Config.Description: Optional local JSON manifest, e.g. /data/providers/providers.json. Only administrator-approved public HLS and local M3U/XMLTV files.

Config.Name: Selected Expanded Channels
Config.Description: Set 1 to enable the completed workbook selection (37 indexed candidates and four readiness-gated broadcasters). Existing lineup retained; playback not yet verified.

Config.Name: Teletext Config
Config.Description: Optional /data/teletext.json; embedded default otherwise.

Config.Name: Teletext Video
Config.Description: Set 1 to add optional channel 995.
